authors.bio: Xavier Ducloux is marketing innovation manager at Harmonic, Rennes, France. With more than 25 years of experience in the video compression and digital TV industry, he is in-charge of developing innovation in the video field through proof of concepts and is active in Motion Picture Experts Group (MPEG) standardization as Harmonic’s representative at MPEG meetings.
authors.name: Xavier Ducloux

authors.bio: Thierry Fautier is the vice president of video strategy at Harmonic, San Jose, CA, where he is in-charge of defining and driving the execution of the long-term strategy of Harmonic’s video business. He is also the co-chair of the MPEG Roadmap Committee.
